{07 15 00}Right now!{01 00 00 05 00} Right here!{01 00 00 05 00}
It's ON!{01 00 00 05 00} I'm gonna challenge
you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Catch a rare fish{01 00 00 05 00} and come
show it to me! {01 00 00 05 00}Hear me?!

{07 15 00}Whichever of us gets the 
most dangerous fish wins!{01 00 00 05 00}
Danger, baby! 
{07 0b 00}How's that? {01 00 00 05 00}You like it,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Just nüüd!{01 00 00 05 00} Just siin!{01 00 00 05 00}
See ON käes!{01 00 00 05 00} Kutsun sind
välja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Püüa haruldane kala{01 00 00 05 00} ja
tule näita mulle! {01 00 00 05 00}Kuuled?!

{07 15 00}Kumb meist saab ohtlikuma 
kala, see võidab!{01 00 00 05 00}
Ohtu, beebi! 
{07 0b 00}Kuidas on? {01 00 00 05 00}Meeldib sulle,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}{ff 00 00 05}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} You're looking
about as dull as dirt!

{07 06 00}Why don't you go catch a
rare fish and surprise me?

{07 14 00}I'm gonna try to catch a
lot better fish than yours
in the meanwhile!
Let's make it a real battle!{01 00 00 03 00}
A battle for the season's
rarest fish, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}{ff 00 00 05}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Sa näed välja
sama tuim kui muld!

{07 06 00}Mine püüa haruldane kala
ja üllata mind!

{07 14 00}Mina üritan vahepeal
püüda sinu omast palju
parema kala!
Teeme sellest lahingu!{01 00 00 03 00}
Lahing hooaja haruldaseima
kala nimel, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Look, there's no doubt that
a ton of weird fish are in
the world, just chilling.
{07 06 00}Just once, I wanna see an
amazing fish that'll give
me a HUGE adrenaline rush!
{07 15 00}So, c'mon {01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 16 00}Why don't you go catch
a fish like that?!
{07 14 00}I'll try too,{01 00 00 03 00} so we can
compare which of us got
the best one, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
What you need to get is
a rarer fish than mine!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}How's that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Vaata, pole kahtlust, et
maailmas on palju imelikke
kalu, kes niisama lesivad.
{07 06 00}Kasvõi korra tahan näha
hämmastavat kala, mis
annab HIIGLA adrenaliini!
{07 15 00}Nii et tule {01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 16 00}Mine püüa selline
kala, eks?!
{07 14 00}Mina proovin ka,{01 00 00 03 00} siis saame
võrrelda, kumb meist sai
parema, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Sul on vaja saada
minu omast haruldasem!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}Kuidas on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
